Whisper base model distribution notice

Model card ID: openai/whisper-base
Canonical model card: https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-base
Bundled artifact: ggml-base.bin, multilingual whisper.cpp GGML conversion

This bundled model is used only for local speech recognition in WordCovenant.
It can produce inaccurate, incomplete, or fabricated text, especially for
short, noisy, overlapping, domain-specific, or underrepresented-language
speech. It does not identify people, verify identity, or establish a fact.

Review the canonical model card and license terms before using its output for
high-impact decisions. WordCovenant keeps microphone PCM and transcription
inference on the device; opening the canonical model-card URL is not required
to use the bundled model.
